# ![](https://app.gusto.com/companies/837abcb0-c8ca-4571-b53d-88f62976c34a/logo?v=1756138750)    Digital Authority PartnersDigital Marketing Account Manager  Remote  ·   Full time      [Apply for Digital Marketing Account Manager](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/digital-authority-partners-digital-marketing-account-manager-4516f3ba-d3b2-46bb-8de0-ac156b439995/applicants/new)

You will be the day-to-day point of contact for several clients, keeping them updated, reporting results, answering their requests, and ensuring the delivery of great quality work.

### About Digital Authority Partners

As an integrated digital agency, we ensure our customers get ahead of their competition by optimizing their end-to-end marketing funnel. From SEO to advertising, marketing automation to testing and optimization, we are a one-stop shop for companies ready to evolve, compete, and grow in a rapidly changing world.

### Description

**Job Title: Digital Marketing Account Manager**

We are looking for a **Digital Marketing Account Manager** who is energetic, organized, and data-driven to exceed client expectations.

**The Agency**

We’re a growing agency, and are looking for the right person to become an essential part of the team!

As an integrated digital agency, we ensure our customers get ahead of their competition by optimizing their end-to-end marketing funnel.

From SEO landing pages to digital PPC advertising, email marketing automation to testing and optimization, we are a one-stop shop for companies ready to evolve, compete, and grow in a rapidly changing world.

DAP has strong benefits such as 401k matching, flexible work-from-home, unlimited vacation, and fully paid healthcare coverage.

**The Role**

You will support around 10 small and medium-sized B2B and B2C clients across healthcare, financial services, education, e-commerce, and others. This takes the ability to quickly shift attention and focus from one client to another and manage multiple tasks at once. Organizational skills are key.

You will be the day-to-day point of contact for several clients, keeping them updated, reporting results, answering their requests, and ensuring the delivery of great quality work. You’ll report to and have the support of the lead Account Manager and work closely with project management to help orchestrate projects internally.

**The Ideal Candidate**

As an Account Manager, you love the idea of spending time with clients, helping them and understanding their project needs, and giving them support. We’re looking for a personable relationship manager who can respond quickly and effectively with a positive, solution-based approach. Eager, enthusiastic, and positive.

Your success is focused on getting the job done well, driving results, and satisfied clients who trust you. As part of the Account Management team, you will have high-level assistance with overarching client strategy and support for your professional growth.

**Responsibilities:**

- Frequent communication with clients on the status of deliverables.
- Provide well-thought-out emails and responses with helpful details and clear next steps.
- Detail-oriented notes and follow-ups internally and externally.
- Work with managers across each functional area on tactical and strategic deliverables.
- Support the planning, execution, and measurement of marketing deliverables.
- Monitor and report on marketing deliverables and success to clients every week.
- Manage timelines of deliverables on the project management platform, Asana.
- Ensure the quality of deliverables before sending to the client.
- Ensure timelines are being met with the foresight of progress alongside the Project Manager.
- Identify new areas of opportunity within the client’s business.
- Troubleshoot issues as they arise for clients.

**Qualifications:**

Mandatory: _4+ years of direct employment (not as a consultant) with an account services title at a marketing agency._

- Digital marketing experience, including SEO, landing pages, PPC, email marketing automation, and reporting.
- Experience working with B2B clients.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience overseeing the creation of marketing collateral, including white papers, webinars, content, email, banners/ads.

**Required Skills:**

- Must be able to prioritize multiple competing clients and tasks
- Empathetic to client needs
- Data-driven with the ability to review, understand and speak to metrics
- Ability to effectively understand and oversee a project from start to finish
- Problem-solving: troubleshooting, involving the right people where necessary
- Combines an analytical mindset with creative thinking

**About Us**

Digital Authority Partners (DAP) is an integrated digital agency with six core competencies: Digital Marketing, SEO, Demand Generation, Lead Generation, Pay-Per-Click, Consulting, eCommerce marketing, Design, Development, and Analytics.

We are a client-first agency, focusing on long-term, foundational solutions rather than short-term, low-impact projects. Our values of purpose, excellence, and transparency drive not only our client relationships but our culture.

We are a growing agency and are looking for the right person to become an important part of our team!

**Perks:**

401(k) matching

Excellent health coverage

Remote working available

[Apply for Digital Marketing Account Manager](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/digital-authority-partners-digital-marketing-account-manager-4516f3ba-d3b2-46bb-8de0-ac156b439995/applicants/new)
